sample.task:
(In the clubroom, Monika and the rest of the girls are waiting for Natsuki.)

Vanessa: “How much longer do we have to wait?! I can feel Shelob moving around in here - she’s trying to come out!”

Cupa: “Vanessa, I really hope your water doesn’t break during our club meeting.”

Sayori: “Has anybody tried calling Natsuki on the phone?”

Monika: “We don’t even know where she’s keeping her phone. More importantly, Ayumi and I are already 4 months pregnant with our own daughters!”

Ayumi: “And since Natsuki and Vanessa are ready to pop, its only a matter of time before we get to see their daughters.”

Yuri: (lifting up her school uniform) “Can you please keep the voice down? Violet’s kicking up a storm in here - and her kicks are pretty painful.”

Andr: (also lifting up her school uniform) “I get that feeling, Yuri. Scarlet’s really active today - she’s getting restless.”

Sayori: “How come Cupa and I are the only girls in the club who AREN’T pregnant?”

Cupa: “I have no idea, Sayori. I just want to have kids.”

(Suddenly, the clubroom doors swing open and Natsuki bursts into the room)

Natsuki: “Guys, sorry I’m late. There was a sale going on at the manga store and I just HAD to get the newest installment of Parfait Girls.”

Vanessa: “Finally! We were about to send out a search party!”

(Monika looks at her belly)

Monika: "I think my daughter's kicking!"

Ayumi: "Oh my god, mine too!"
sample.chosen:
Natsuki: "Whoa, looks like I missed a lot while I was gone! Congrats, you guys! I can't wait to meet the new additions to our little club."

Sayori: "Natsuki, you're not pregnant?"

Natsuki: "Nope, not yet. But I'm definitely looking forward to it. I've always wanted to be a mom."

Cupa: "Same here, Natsuki. I can't wait to hold my own baby in my arms."

Yuri: "I'm just glad that we're all supportive of each other, no matter what stage of life we're in."

Andr: "Definitely. We're all in this together."

Monika: "Absolutely. And speaking of being in this together, I think it's time we start discussing our plans for the upcoming school festival. We want to make sure our daughters get to experience it, too."

Natsuki: "Great idea, Monika! I've already got some ideas for decorations and activities. Let's get to it!"

(The girls gather around the table, excitedly discussing their plans for the school festival as they eagerly await the arrival of their daughters.)
